scientific_stage: Prospective validation of the already-frozen M2 method on one untouched public composition condition G1
purpose: Test whether the frozen M2 small diverse equal-weight ensemble improves graph-level sigma prediction over the frozen single-model M1 baseline when the same provider cards are recomposed under a new public deterministic network embedding, without changing provider workload semantics or using G1 white-box evidence for design, fitting, selection, weighting, or repair.

evidence_role.chapter_close_rule: M2 is frozen permanently after this G1 evaluation regardless of outcome. No G1-driven repair is permitted inside M2.

frozen_method.I1: unchanged frozen public rho-conditioned provider cards
frozen_method.M0: unchanged independent-product probability rule with G1-specific deterministic forward boundary algebra
frozen_method.M1: unchanged frozen single latent provider surrogate per provider

M2_joint_ensemble.point_prediction: arithmetic mean of the 27 member sigma_G curves

G1_public_condition.scientific_change_from_G0: Keep the same logical parallel-all composition, provider workload, provider cards, fixed service stages, message sizes, bandwidth and QoS semantics, but replace the symmetric provider-branch propagation delays by a frozen asymmetric public network embedding.
G1_public_condition.reason_for_condition: This changes which branch can dominate end-to-end latency while preserving the local periodic workload seen by every provider, so the existing I1 provider cards remain the intended information interface.

provider_branch_PR_assignment_provenance.purpose: Mechanical provider assignment avoids hand-tuning the asymmetric stress condition to G0 provider-specific behavior.

G1_boundary_algebra.branch_formula: delta_i = branch_bytes/(BW*1e6) + 2*PR_i, where the second PR_i is the zero-byte completion-control return to the ParAll controller
G1_boundary_algebra.A_G_policy: At each frozen same-rho region, forward-compose the already-frozen provider A_i boundaries through this G1 algebra. The resulting A_G1 is identical across M0, M1, all 27 M2 members, and WB evaluation.

must_hash: M0 contract and G1 adapter implementation

whitebox_protocol.private_provider_models: Use the same frozen Phase-1 hidden provider models that generated the G0 reference. Do not refit or replace them.

evaluation.surface: all 5 frozen rho values x all frozen horizons, including H=0
evaluation.Jaccard_D_A: N/A because the same frozen A_G1 is used by all methods and WB

prospective_success_criteria.primary: M2 whole-surface MAE is strictly lower than M1 whole-surface MAE.
prospective_success_criteria.confirmatory: M2 whole-surface RMSE is strictly lower than M1 whole-surface RMSE.
prospective_success_criteria.rho_consistency: M2 MAE is lower than M1 MAE in at least 3 of the 5 frozen rho slices.
prospective_success_criteria.M0_comparison: Report M2 versus M0, but M0 is not needed to define the primary prospective success claim.
prospective_success_criteria.ambiguity_range: No pass/fail coverage threshold is imposed because the frozen finite 27-member range is not a calibrated confidence interval. Coverage and width are descriptive prospective diagnostics.
prospective_success_criteria.failure_rule: If the primary criterion fails, the prospective improvement claim is not supported. M2 nevertheless remains frozen and the M2 chapter closes with the observed limitation; no G1-driven repair is permitted.

chapter_close_outputs: G1 overall and per-rho metric summaries
final M2 chapter-close note stating prospective outcome and limitations
next_gate: Implement the public G1 asymmetric-path simulator and deterministic M0 adapter without reading or generating G1 white-box evidence. Smoke-test only the prediction side, then run and freeze the full blind G1 M0/M1/M2 predictions before any actual G1 white-box generation.
